descriptionFull: The yellow-breasted chat ( Icteria virens ) is a large songbird found in North America, and is the only member of the family Icteriidae . It was once a member of the New World warbler family, but in 2017 the AOS (American Ornithological Society) moved it to its own family. Its placement is not definitely resolved.
